sourceData.meaningMnemonic: The <radical>king</radical>'s <radical>village</radical> is the <kanji>reason</kanji> he's king. Without the village there would be no reason to have a king in the first place.
sourceData.meaningInfo: If a king has no one to rule then he has no reason to exist.
sourceData.readingInfo: Just like you can't have a king without a village, you can't have reason without re.
